title: Off-roading in a loaf of bread
text: We were supposed to spend a third day hiking back to the road, but storms overnight turned the track into thick mud. So, we ended up splitting an off-road taxi with some people from our yurt camp. The local drivers use old Soviet 4x4 vehicles to manage the terrain. The UAZ we rode in is known as a Bukhanka (“loaf of bread”) in Russian. The drive took over two hours even though the distance was only around 16 km.
